items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I don't even know where Lonzo White died, he died. I don't know where his children are.

ctx.x: Was his party record? His party record that I can't remember. It's someplace but it's in

a vault somewhere and somebody has it. Somebody has it but I never even got a copy. I was supposed to have gotten a copy but I didn't even get a copy. So I don't even know where Lonzo White died, he died. I don't know where his children are. I don't know if they even have a copy of it or not. But nevertheless, I do remember that. This band was something else. It was like a
family. How long were you all together? Oh man, I must have been with him about four or
